children: Crypto investment firm Bit Digital has transferred a large amount of Ethereum to Galaxy Digital, fueling speculation that it may be preparing to sell.
On-chain analytics firm Lookonchain said on Nov. 20 that Bit Digital deposited 16,639 ETH with Galaxy Digital. The holdings were worth about $26.3 million at the time of the transfer.
Lookonchain said the large transfer suggests Bit Digital may be moving to sell Ethereum. Actual sales, however, have not been confirmed.
As of Oct. 31, Bit Digital held 163,241.7 ETH, with an average purchase price of $3,007.63.
Following the recent sharp drop in Ethereum prices, Bit Digital's unrealized loss was estimated at about $237 million.

title: Bit Digital Transfers 16,639 ETH to Galaxy Digital, Fueling Sale Speculation
